Keep synchronous caller cancellation and every ancestor Owner gate through nested subscription projection and source cleanup. Deterministic source-drain contention regression rejects post-cancel reads and sealing. Correct replication test fault injection to reject each coalesced item; retain exact repair obligations and durable catch-up assertions.
